title: 第2300章 斩杀布代第2299章 对战布代
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
这一次，江尘将强大的力量灌注进入魔魂刀，加上强大的力量，直接斩向布代。
布代以为这一击，他依然能挡住，于是动用一招防御武技挡在前方，想将江尘的这一击给挡住。
魔魂刀斩在布代的防御武技上，布代的防御武技瞬间破碎。
然后魔魂刀狠狠地朝布代斩落。
布代面色一变。
本来江尘原先能跟布代打得不相上下，说明江尘的实力不弱于布代，布代相当震惊了。
现在江尘居然能瞬间地破掉他的防御武技，这可是能威胁到布代了。
布代马上躲避，但是终究是慢了一些，江尘的速度也是极快的。
江尘的魔魂刀斩在布代的右臂上。
布代的右臂如同豆腐般，被魔魂刀轻轻地切掉，整个右肩膀加上右臂，直接跟身体分离。
剧烈的痛感，让布代惨叫一声。
魔血飞溅。
布代被重创。
“啊......”布代不停地后退，一脸惊恐地看向江尘。
幸好刚才布代躲了一下，才没有被江尘一刀斩成两截。
凭江尘刚才这一刀的威力，将他斩成两截，完全没有丝毫问题，布代深知刚才江尘这一刀的威力。
“想跑？你还是给我去死吧。”江尘直接追上来，这一次，江尘也是动用灭天一击秘术，将自己的速度也是增强了。
现在布代受了重伤，战力有所下降。
江尘没有丝毫伤势，还强化了自己的速度，布代怎么可能躲得过？
这一次，江尘看准的是布代身体，一道刀光闪过。

布代的身体定住了，接下来就是身上出现了一道伤口，布代整个身体变成两截，被江尘斜着斩成两截。
“丹火。”江尘此时手中出现一团火焰，然后快速地变大，丹火在江尘的灭天一击的强化下，化为二十倍威力，直接将布代的所有身体给包裹住了。
布代虽然身体被斩成两截，但是布代的修为高，生命力强大，也没有马上死去，元神还没有来得及逃离，就被江尘的丹火给包围了。
根本无法逃生。
元神最快就是至阳至刚的东西了。
“啊......江尘，不要杀我，不要杀我，饶我一命。”火焰中，是布代的求饶之声。
还有惨叫之声。
其他魔族看到这一幕，面露恐惧之色。
他们倚仗，一名圣人境的强者，居然不是对手？
布代败了，那么他们这些人，如何战胜江尘？
再说，江尘带来的强者数量极多，都是南部区域的精锐，还有江尘能斩杀圣人境强者，他们这些魔族的数量虽然多，但是完全不可能是对手。
江尘冷眼盯着布代的尸体被烧，完全没有回应。
布代惨叫，得知江尘并没有收手，转而开始骂怨毒的话，但是声音越来越弱。
不一会儿，布代的声音就是消失了。
布代的元神也被丹火烧成虚无。
布代的残尸也是化为一片焦炭。
魔天幻看到这一幕，此时内心极其恐惧。
天呐，他刚才到底是跟什么样的存在交手啊？
刚才江尘并没有出全力，如果江尘刚才真是出全力的话，魔天幻现在已经是一具尸体了。
“好了，现在轮到你们了。”江尘转身看向魔天幻等人。
content_en:
This time, Jiang Chen poured powerful power into the Demonic Soul Sword, and with the powerful power, he slashed directly at Budai.
Bu Dai thought that he could still block this blow, so he used a defensive martial skill to stand in front of him, hoping to block Jiang Chen's blow.
The Demonic Soul Sword struck Budai's defensive martial arts, and Budai's defensive martial arts instantly shattered.
Then the Demonic Soul Sword slashed down towards Budai.
Budai's expression changed.
Originally, Jiang Chen was able to fight equally with Bu Dai, indicating that Jiang Chen's strength was not weaker than Bu Dai's, Bu Dai was quite shocked.
Now Jiang Chen can actually break through his defensive martial arts in an instant, which can threaten Budai.
Bu Dai immediately dodged, but in the end it was a little slower, and Jiang Chen was also extremely fast.
Jiang Chen's Demonic Soul Sword struck Budai's right arm.
Budai's right arm was like tofu, gently cut off by the Demon Soul Sword, and the entire right shoulder and right arm were directly separated from the body.
The severe pain made Budai scream.
Demonic blood splattered.
Budai was severely wounded.
"Ah..." Bu Dai kept backing up and looked at Jiang Chen with a horrified expression.
Fortunately, Bu Dai had just dodged and was not cut into two pieces by Jiang Chen.
With the power of Jiang Chen's sword just now, he could be cut into two pieces without any problem. Bu Dai knew the power of Jiang Chen's sword just now.
"Want to run? You'd better die for me." Jiang Chen caught up directly. This time, Jiang Chen also used the secret technique of the Sky-Destroying Strike to increase his speed.
Now Budai is seriously injured and his combat effectiveness has declined.
Jiang Chen was not injured at all, and his speed had also been enhanced. How could Bu Dai escape?
This time, Jiang Chen focused on Budai's body, and a sword flashed past.
Bu Dai's body froze, and then a wound appeared on his body. Bu Dai's entire body turned into two pieces, and Jiang Chen slashed him diagonally into two pieces.
"Elixir fire." At this moment, a ball of flame appeared in Jiang Chen's hand, and then quickly grew in size. Enhanced by Jiang Chen's sky-destroying strike, the elixir fire became twenty times more powerful, directly covering Budai's entire body.
Although Bu Dai's body was cut into two pieces, Bu Dai's cultivation level was high and his vitality was strong, so he did not die immediately. Before his soul could escape, he was surrounded by Jiang Chen's pill fire.
There was no way to escape.
The fastest soul is the most yang and strong thing.
"Ah...Jiang Chen, don't kill me, don't kill me, spare my life." In the flames, Bu Dai's voice begged for mercy.
There were also screams.
When other demons saw this scene, their faces showed fear.
They relied on a strong man in the saint realm, but he was no match?
Bu Dai was defeated, so how could they defeat Jiang Chen?
Besides, Jiang Chen brought a large number of strong men, all of whom were elites from the southern region, and Jiang Chen was able to kill strong men in the saint realm. Although these demons were large in number, they could not be their opponents at all.
Jiang Chen stared coldly at Bu Dai's body being burned, without responding at all.
Bu Dai screamed, and when he learned that Jiang Chen did not stop, he started to curse vicious words, but his voice became weaker and weaker.
After a while, Budai's voice disappeared.
Butai's soul was also burned into nothingness by the elixir fire.
Butai's remains were also turned into charcoal.
When Mo Tianhuan saw this scene, he was extremely frightened.
God, what kind of existence did he fight just now?
Jiang Chen didn't use all his strength just now. If Jiang Chen really used all his strength just now, Mo Tianhuan would be a corpse now.
"Okay, now it's your turn." Jiang Chen turned around and looked at Mo Tianhuan and the others.
